JKSET AGENCY

Hazratbal Srinagar-190006, J&K. Email: profaijaz@uok.edu.in; M: 9596137387

Dated: 20.08.2026
Extension Notification
It is hereby notified for information of all concerned candidates that the last dates
for submission of online application forms for JKSET/LASET 2026 have been extended
in view of audit and security-related issues of the website that resulted in a delay of five
days in the commencement of the online application process.
In order to compensate for the delay and provide adequate opportunity to all
eligible candidates to submit their applications, the revised schedule shall be as follows:
Particulars Existing Last Date Extended Last Date
Last date for online submission of
application forms without late fee 20th August, 2026 25th August, 2026
Last date for online submission of
application forms with late fee 25th August, 2026 30th August, 2026
Accordingly, all eligible candidates intending to appear in JKSET/LASET 2026
are advised to complete and submit their online application forms within the revised dates
mentioned above.
Candidates are further advised to carefully read the prescribed instructions and
guidelines and ensure that their application forms are complete in all respects before final
submission. Candidates should also ensure that the requisite fee, wherever applicable, is
deposited within the stipulated time.
Prof Aijaz Ahmad
Member Secretary
